moworks.notes: Idea and numbers (TakayuStudio tx-yakumono-pause, written here): From 0.35 s, chars appear at 60 ms per char (recipe 40–60); +200 ms after '、 , ，' and +400 ms after '。 . ！ ! ？ ?' (recipe 100–200 / 250–400); closing quotes and brackets appear with the previous char and the pause comes after them; schedule compressed to 1.9 s if longer. Each char fades in over 60 ms rising 3 px. Accent caret 2.5 px after the last char: steady while typing, then blinks (0.5 s period, 55 % on). Exit 3.1–3.4 s. Loop 3.6 s. Params: nhịp ký tự (60 ms) · nghỉ sau dấu phẩy (200 ms) · nghỉ sau dấu chấm (400 ms). Closing quotes and brackets come with the character before them, and the pause falls after them.
